title: Final Marian antiphons Ma1–Ma4 (Alma Redemptoris, Ave Regina, Salve Regina, Sub tuum) have no day code: where do they load?
prompt: The index codes the Compline final Marian antiphons as '— | C | Ma1/Ma1b' (Alma Redemptoris, p689/690), 'Ma2/Ma2b' (Ave Regina caelorum, p691), 'Ma3/Ma3b' (Salve Regina, p692) and 'Ma4' (Sub tuum praesidium, p695), with no day code. Only Regina caeli carries one ('TP | V | Ma5…', intake #15). The mapper gives them COMPLINE.antMar with option_txt 'Antiphona finalis n' (+ ' (altera melodia)' for the b settings), but the loader skips them with 'no day code', so no LPS rows. pp689–695 print no seasonal rubric, only the heading 'Antiphonae finales ad Beatam Mariam Virginem' and '[simpl.]' over the b settings. Identities for Ma1 (gregobase:8146, solemn, AM 173) and Ma1b (gregobase:16751, simple tone, AM 178) are already set. A side point: the b settings are printed '[simpl.]'. Their option_txt could follow the Ma5b precedent ('Tonus simplex (modus N)') instead of '(altera melodia)'.

options.label: Null epoch, every day: COMPLINE.antMar options 1..n in the book's order (Ma1, Ma1b, Ma2, …, Ma4), option_txt 'Antiphona finalis n' / 'Tonus simplex (modus N)'
options.detail: matches the book (no seasonal rubric printed; the 1971 Office lets any of them be used outside Paschaltide); Regina caeli stays TP option 1

options.label: Traditional seasons: Alma Redemptoris Advent–2 Feb, Ave Regina 2 Feb–Holy Week, Salve Regina after Pentecost; Sub tuum null-epoch option
options.detail: needs epoch slugs per season; the book itself doesn't print these
